llm_response.reason: The site promises extremely high and guaranteed ROI (up to 80%), targets psychological weaknesses through urgency and easy novice onboarding, uses unverifiable and generic testimonials, offers instant withdrawals and accepts mostly cryptocurrency (a common scam vector). There is ambiguity in privacy wording and lack of genuine business contacts, strongly matching known investment scam characteristics.
